sample_unit: LLM responses (conversation threads) classifying glenoid diagrams

links.outcome: Accuracy of general-purpose LLMs classifying Walch glenoid diagrams
links.effect: DeepSeek achieved 44% accuracy (7/16), while Claude had 0% accuracy (0/16); both insufficient for clinical use despite general LLM capability claims.
links.quote: DeepSeek achieved 44% accuracy (7/16), while Claude had 0% accuracy (0/16).

links.outcome: Response accuracy variation across prompt instruction lengths and conversation threads
links.effect: Accuracy varied with prompt length (22 to 864 words for DeepSeek, 127 to 840 for Claude); DeepSeek showed mild positive correlation between instruction length and accuracy.
links.quote: DeepSeek showed a mild positive correlation between instruction length and response accuracy.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation/benchmark testing the diagnostic classification accuracy of multimodal LLMs (Claude 3.5 Sonnet and DeepSeek R1) on orthopedic diagrams without testing an organizational deployment safeguard or practice.
